support_tickets.subject: Inquiry regarding GST input tax credit invoice format

messages.text: Can I add my firm GSTIN on the tax invoice for B2B input tax credit claiming?

Yes! All BharatKart invoices feature full 18% CGST/SGST/IGST breakdowns compliant with the GST Council. You can input your 15-digit GSTIN under Profile > Tax Details to reflect on all upcoming tax invoices.
